description: For lawn care, this inspection checklist records scheduled mowing, edging, blowing, bed work, weather adjustment, seasonal instruction, and approved extras. Its supporting evidence includes route timestamps, before-and-after photos, turf condition, irrigation damage, service completion, and product details.

blocks.label: Lawn Care Context

sections.guidance: Identify the lawn care service, reviewed areas, crew, and customer.
sections.title: Account and Service Cycle

blocks.guidance: Mark each lawn care item after direct review.
items: Mowing height and pattern match the property instruction
Edges, beds, sidewalks, and drive areas are clean
Gates, irrigation heads, ornaments, and obstacles are undamaged
Skipped or saturated turf zones have a recorded reason
Approved seasonal tasks and add-ons are reconciled
Clippings, equipment marks, photos, and property security are checked

title: Lawn Care Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during recurring property lawn-care record when the lawn care record must identify account route, turf sections, gates, irrigation heads, obstacles, treatment zones, equipment limits, and preferences. Complete the applicable handoff for property security check, skipped-zone reason, corrective visit, customer notification, and next route instruction.
